system_deep_field.name: Deep Field
system_deep_field.description: Aggressive shadow lift and noise reduction for faint wide fields.

system_lunar.name: Lunar
system_lunar.description: High micro-contrast and sharpness, muted colour for the Moon.

system_cluster.name: Cluster

editor.discard_body: Loading another photo will discard the adjustments you've made to this one.

start.help: Begin here: a one-click starting point with Auto Astro, or apply a saved preset. Then work down the steps.

stack.help: The linear stacked composite, before any creative work: stretch the faint signal, subtract the sky gradient, neutralise the colour. Non-destructive - it all recomputes from the 32-bit data.

frame.help: Set the frame first - crop, level the horizon, rotate or flip. Everything after this works on the framed image.
frame.unavailable: Framing needs the original image dimensions, which aren't available for a stacked composite.

sky.help: Clean up the raw signal before any creative grading: white balance, lens vignetting, light-pollution gradients, and haze.

light.help: Overall exposure and tonal balance - how bright, contrasty, and full of shadow and highlight detail the image reads.

curves.help: Fine-tune tone and colour with a master curve, then per-channel red/green/blue curves for grading.

colour.help: How vivid the colours are. Vibrance protects already-saturated areas; saturation scales everything.

detail.help: Local texture: micro-contrast, noise reduction, and sharpening. Do this after tone and colour are settled.

stars.help: Two ways to handle stars: shrink them where they are, or lift them out entirely so the rest of your edit only touches the nebula.

depth.help: Pick the focal point, then open the Depth Shift viewer for an interactive parallax preview.

export.help: Get the result out: download it, hand it to AstroDex, or save the current settings as a reusable preset.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.help: Save the current adjustments so you can jump back to this point if you push a slider too far. Kept only for this image.

image_preview.click_to_set_focal_point: Click the image to set the focal point

token_manager.heading: AstroDex webhook tokens
token_manager.copy_now_warning: Copy these now, they are not shown again.

tone_curve.title: Tone curve
tone_curve.help: Drag a point to reshape the curve, double-click empty space to add one, double-click a point to remove it.

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.hint: Stretches the tonal range around the image's midpoint, separating faint detail from bright.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Shifts overall luminance up or down.

highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.hint: Recovers or boosts bright detail - weighted toward the brightest pixels only.

shadows.label: Shadows
shadows.hint: Lifts or deepens dark detail - weighted toward the darkest pixels only.

whites.label: Whites
whites.hint: Pushes the white clipping point - narrower and more aggressive than Highlights, only the near-white tail.

blacks.label: Blacks
blacks.hint: Pushes the black clipping point - narrower and more aggressive than Shadows, only the near-black tail.

vignetteCorrection.label: Vignette correction
vignetteCorrection.hint: Brightens the corners to counteract lens vignetting.

gradientReduction.label: Gradient reduction
gradientReduction.hint: Flattens smooth background gradients - light pollution, sky glow.

dehaze.label: Dehaze
dehaze.hint: Restores contrast and colour lost to a veiling haze or light-pollution glow.

clarity.label: Clarity
clarity.hint: Local contrast via unsharp masking. Negative values soften instead.

denoise.label: Denoise
denoise.hint: Edge-preserving smoothing. Higher trades fine detail for a cleaner background.

chromaDenoise.label: Colour noise reduction
chromaDenoise.hint: Smooths colour speckle only, leaving brightness detail untouched.

starReduction.label: Star reduction
starReduction.hint: Shrinks and dims star points so faint nebulosity stands out more.

starSensitivity.label: Star sensitivity
starSensitivity.hint: How faint a point can be and still count as a star. Higher finds more, fainter stars.

starMaxSize.label: Star max size
starMaxSize.hint: Caps how large a bright spot can be and still count as a star, so bright cores aren't shrunk.

starRemoval.label: Remove stars
starRemoval.hint: Pulls the stars out so every other adjustment works on the nebula alone.

starRecombine.label: Bring stars back
starRecombine.hint: Screen-blends the removed stars back at the end: 0 keeps the image starless, 100 restores them full strength.

sharpness.label: Sharpness
sharpness.hint: Blurs below 100%, sharpens above via edge enhancement.

vibrance.label: Vibrance
vibrance.hint: Boosts saturation, weighted toward already-muted colours so vivid areas stay natural.

saturation.label: Saturation
saturation.hint: Scales colour intensity uniformly across the whole image.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.hint: White balance: cooler (blue) toward 2000K, warmer (amber) toward 8000K.

tint.label: Tint
tint.hint: White balance: shifts the colour cast between green and magenta.

stretch.label: Stretch
stretch.hint: How hard to lift the faint signal out of the background. Low keeps the sky dark and subtle; high pulls up dim nebulosity at the cost of a brighter, noisier background.

background_extraction.label: Background extraction
background_extraction.hint: Removes a smooth light-pollution / sky-glow gradient by fitting a low-order surface to the sky between the objects. 0 leaves the gradient in; 100 subtracts all of it.

color_calibration.label: Colour calibration
color_calibration.hint: Neutralises the sky background to grey and balances the channels so the star field reads roughly white.

reduce.heading: Reduce
reduce.help: Shrinks each star where it is. Fast, every star kept - reach for this when you just want a tighter field.

remove.heading: Remove (starless)
remove.help: Lifts the stars out so every other step only touches the nebula, then Bring stars back fades them in at the end (0 = keep the image starless). Slower, but lets you stretch and sharpen the nebula without bloating stars.
remove.engine_starnet2_hint: Uses the StarNet2 model installed on the server. The first pass on a new image can take a while; detection controls below don't apply.

detection.heading: Detection
detection.help: What counts as a star. Both Reduce and Remove use these. Turn on the mask to check before committing.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.subheading: Runtime configuration. Stored in the data volume, applied without a redeploy.

logs.label: Logs
logs.blurb: Tail, clear, and export the application log.

max_upload.label: Maximum upload size
max_upload.hint: Uploads larger than this are rejected. Megabytes.

session_ttl.label: Session lifetime
session_ttl.hint: How long a session and its working files are kept. Hours.

preview_size.label: Preview size
preview_size.hint: Longest edge of the fast-display preview image. Pixels.

stacking_max.label: Maximum frames
stacking_max.hint: Upper bound on frames accepted for one stack.

stacking_retention.label: Stack retention
stacking_retention.hint: How long a stack's uploaded frames are kept for re-stacking. The composite keeps the session lifetime. Hours.

stacking_workers.label: Stacking threads
stacking_workers.hint: Parallel threads for the align/combine passes. 0 = auto (CPU count, capped at 4); 1 = sequential. Raise on a many-core machine.

stacking_watch_dir.label: Watch folder
stacking_watch_dir.hint: A server path the worker polls for new frames (empty = off). New images are ingested into a rolling stack you can open from the stacking screen.

stacking_watch_idle.label: Watch auto-stack after
stacking_watch_idle.hint: Process the watch stack once no new frame has arrived for this many minutes.

stacking_watch_auto.label: Auto-stack the watch folder
stacking_watch_auto.hint: When off, watched frames are only ingested - start the stack yourself from the stacking screen.

allowlist.label: Callback URL allowlist
allowlist.hint: One URL prefix per line. An empty list allows any host (development only).

max_retries.label: Maximum retries
max_retries.hint: Delivery attempts before a webhook is marked failed.

cors_origins.label: CORS origins
cors_origins.hint: One origin per line. Takes effect after the api service restarts.

rate_limit_enabled.label: Rate limiting
rate_limit_enabled.hint: Caps how often one IP can upload, process, or stack images.

rate_limit_per_minute.label: Requests per minute
rate_limit_per_minute.hint: Per IP, shared across upload/process/stack endpoints.

max_concurrent_jobs.label: Concurrent jobs
max_concurrent_jobs.hint: Maximum enhance/stack jobs running at once, per IP.

log_file_level.label: File log level
log_file_level.hint: Level written to the rotating log file.

log_console_level.label: Console log level
log_console_level.hint: Level echoed to the container logs.

advanced.external_engines_blurb: Optional star removal (StarNet2) and denoise (DeepSNR). Nothing is bundled: install the binary from starnetastro.com, mount it into the api and worker containers, and point these at it. You are responsible for the tool's own licence terms. Leave blank to keep the classical engines.

starnet2_path.label: StarNet2 binary path
starnet2_path.hint: Absolute path inside the container, e.g. /opt/engines/starnet2/starnet2.

starnet2_stride.label: StarNet2 stride
starnet2_stride.hint: Even, 2-512. 0 lets StarNet2 pick. Larger is faster and coarser.

deepsnr_path.label: DeepSNR binary path
deepsnr_path.hint: Absolute path inside the container. Denoise engine (used on the linear composite path).

logs.levels_hint: Levels - file: {file}, console: {console}. Change them on the Advanced tab.

settings.quality_hint: Score every sub (stars, sharpness, roundness, sky) and drop the worst automatically. You can rescue any frame afterwards.
settings.post_process_hint: Crop the field-rotation edges, flatten the sky gradient and neutralise the colour before the editor.
settings.drizzle_hint: Reconstruct onto a finer grid for real resolution gain from a well-dithered stack. Slower, correlates noise - leave off unless you have hundreds of subs.

upload_zone.accepted_formats: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, FITS or camera RAW

view.review_hint: {total} frames uploaded, {excluded} excluded. Click a thumbnail to preview it; use the checkbox to drop a trailed or clouded sub.
view.result_pending: Run the stack to see the result.

errors.too_few: Add at least {min} frames to stack.
errors.too_many: {count} frames selected - this instance allows at most {max} per stack (raise it in Settings).

grid.exclude: Exclude this frame from the stack

calibration.title: Calibration frames
calibration.hint: Optional master dark, flat and bias frames. They are built into every light frame before debayering to remove thermal signal, vignetting and sensor defects.
calibration.masters_note: Master frames are built when you stack.
